CONFIRMED TO DATE
Guy Rosen

Recently wrapped up 13 years at Meta, where he served as VP of Product and Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). He joined Facebook in 2013 through the acquisition of Onavo, a startup he co-founded, led the growth team, and built its platform safety operation. As CISO he was responsible for cybersecurity across a platform of nearly 4 billion users. In his final year he initiated and led Meta's internal AI adoption program.

Nick Fitz

Founder and general partner at Juniper Ventures, backing companies working to make AI safe, secure, and beneficial. Previously founded Momentum and worked as a senior behavioral scientist at Duke University's Center for Advanced Hindsight, with a career spanning research, company building, and investing.

Avishag Bohbot

Co-Founder of APEX and Solo GP at Velocityˣ, backing exceptional founders in frontier AI and empowering Israel's top technical talent to build global companies.

Adi Foksheneanu Gov

VP of Revenue Marketing and CISO Community Evangelist at Wiz, leading executive engagement across the cybersecurity ecosystem. Previously VP of Business Development at Gem (acquired by Wiz) and Senior Director at Team8.

Dvir Zeltzer

Co-founder of Two Delta, an Israeli AI startup developing technology to accelerate AI models and improve how efficiently they use compute. The company's research spans faster inference and evaluating how AI coding agents build and maintain web applications.

Ilan Komargodski

Associate professor of computer science at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, working on the foundations of computer science with an emphasis on cryptography. Previously a postdoctoral researcher at Cornell Tech. Earned his PhD and master's at the Weizmann Institute of Science.

Marius Hobbhahn

CEO and founder of Apollo Research. Recognized in the TIME100 in AI in 2025. Apollo is an AGI safety research organization specializing in AI scheming, control, and evaluations, and also builds coding agent safety and security products with a focus on AI agent monitoring.

Oleg Lerner

Co-Founder of a stealth startup, bringing deep expertise in cybersecurity, cloud security, and adversarial tactics. Previously a Security Research Team Lead at Sygnia, he led teams analyzing advanced threat actors and building cloud defense tools. Earlier, he served in an elite IDF technological unit, worked as a security researcher at CyberArk, and has spoken at top conferences including DEF CON.

Rotem Lapid

Talpiot graduate and UH60 Helicopter pilot. Former head of AI in Israeli Air Force and Israel's largest school chain. Co-founder of Talpiot Alumni Forum. Working on something new.

Yaron Rosen

Entrepreneur, a16z scout, angel investor, and APEX adviser. A retired brigadier general and former Chief of the IDF Cyber Staff, with more than three decades of military service, including senior Israeli Air Force leadership. A fellow at Reichman University's International Institute for Counter-Terrorism.

Tal Fialkow

Chief AI Officer at Two Delta and part of the team behind APEX. Works at the intersection of AI models, infrastructure, and real-world deployment, helping build Israel's AI ecosystem.

Roy Nissim

Leads distributed inference at Red Hat (vLLM, llm-d, Inference Gateway). He co-founded Jounce, an AI inference startup acquired by Red Hat, and SignaLife, a healthcare AI startup now in advanced clinical trials. A Talpiot alumnus, he holds a PhD in high-performance computing and a Global MBA, and co-founded APEX, a launchpad for Israel's top technical talent.

Yossi Gandelsman

Researcher at OpenAI and an assistant professor on leave from the Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago (TTIC). He studies how AI models process images and language and the mechanisms behind them. PhD at UC Berkeley, master's at the Weizmann Institute of Science. Before graduate school, he worked at Google.

Sapir Hadad

Serial entrepreneur and Co-Founder & CEO of Echo Labs, building the foundational infrastructure for humans and AI agents to build, train, and deploy intelligence in the physical world. Previously she founded and led Fiverr's AI & Physical Lab following the acquisition of her startup.

Shay Yahal

Co-founder, safety and security for recursively self-improving AI systems. 12 years of experience across the IDF and cybersecurity industry, from hands-on research to leading teams of up to 150 security researchers. Also studied mathematics, philosophy, and psychology. Over the past year focused on AI safety research, in San Francisco, working on alignment and frontier AI security.

Nimrod Harel

Father of Lily and husband of Shira. Has been in the world of AI for the past decade, through a master's and a PhD at Tel Aviv University and work as a researcher at Samsung and IBM. In recent months he has been founding Valu, which focuses on energy management in AI servers and running models in an energy-efficient way.

Amit Yampolsky

CEO of Rizz, a startup in the AI Infra space. Before founding the company, he was VP Sales at Koi, which was sold earlier this year to Palo Alto Networks.

Shelly Schwartzer

Runs the 8200 Startups Forum, a community of thousands of unit members and alumni, and was the first employee on the founding team of a cyber company, a seed investment by a16z.

Ilan Kadar

CEO and co-founder of Plurai, an AI infra company building a Recursive Self-Improvement Layer for AI agents. PhD in machine learning, formerly EVP AI at Nexar.

Nehoray Erdinast Ofri

CEO, entrepreneur, policy consultant, researcher, and social innovator. After several years in government and policy (future of work and foreign affairs), moved into tech and founded Skillsup. Today founder and CEO of Community O, an NGO that brings together entrepreneurship and philanthropy at scale. Since October 7 it has supported over 45 initiatives and mobilized more than 400M NIS in funding.

Daniel Ohayon

Started in Psagot at the Technion, focusing on AI. Joined 8200's Center 60 on its founding team, which trained the unit's Speech-to-Text and speaker identification models. Master's at the Technion focused on AI, then Research Scientist working on model training and inference optimizations; a paper of his was recently accepted to NeurIPS. A year ago joined Corma's founding team as one of the first employees, working on training its foundation model for cybersecurity and on the product.

Sol Fine Dreyfus

Co-founder and CEO of Intent Robotics, a Physical AI company building an agency platform that enables robots to understand, reason and act autonomously in complex, real-world environments, turning them into autonomous workers.

Esben Kran

Partner at Juniper Ventures, which backs AI security and safety companies. He founded Apart Research, a non-profit AI safety lab, and co-founded Seldon Lab, an accelerator for AI security startups. In Tel Aviv he wants to meet founders building in AI security.

Kristian Rönn

Co-founder and CEO of Lucid Computing and co-founder of carbon-accounting company Normative. His work spans AI hardware governance and global catastrophic risk. Before starting Normative, he worked at the University of Oxford's Future of Humanity Institute. His background combines mathematics, philosophy, computer science, and AI.

Nir On

30 years of experience from the Israeli defense and intelligence community, in senior leadership roles managing complex, multidisciplinary teams, focused on bridging deep technology with operational execution in high-stakes environments. Today Founding Partner at CAST (Day Zero Lab), helping early-stage founders turn ambitious ideas into scalable businesses.

Gilad Katz

Co-founder and CEO of a stealth venture. Previously worked in AI security research and in cybersecurity R&D in Israeli Military Intelligence, with experience as an engineer and team lead.

Eithan Shaar

Co-founder & CTO of Aleph Intelligence. Earned his CS degree by 19 and did his MSc at Bar-Ilan University with Prof. Gal Chechik. Before Aleph, AI lead at Mentee Robotics. Aleph helps robotics teams find where their systems fail by turning real-world footage into simulations for testing and training.

Tomer Avlakosh

Israel Sales Lead at Nebius, a Nasdaq-listed global AI infrastructure company. Over a decade of experience in sales and leadership roles at leading technology companies, including MongoDB and Salesforce. Focuses on building strategic partnerships with technology companies, startups, and government organizations, driving the adoption and expansion of AI infrastructure in Israel.

Amir Mallak

AI researcher and PhD student specializing in foundational machine learning, generative models, and robust physical AI. Collaborates with MIT CSAIL, researcher with Project CETI, previously AI research at AWS AI Labs, and served as a Captain in Unit 81 of the Intelligence Corps. Now exploring an ambitious frontier-AI startup.

Aviad Bohbot

Co-founder of AGEERA, developing and deploying battery energy storage and energy-management solutions. Works on projects that help commercial and industrial customers manage electricity use, navigate grid constraints, and get more value from their energy infrastructure.

Nativ Ben Or

Leads TriEdge's Israel operations, supporting investments, company building, and impact initiatives. Previously invested at Hanaco Ventures and Aurelius Capital, following 15 years in the IDF's Intelligence Directorate, including service as Deputy Chief of Staff and Intelligence Aide to the Chief of the General Staff.

Aviv Sela

Former Intelligence and Operations Officer in Israel's intelligence community. She has held senior marketing and strategy roles across travel and fintech. She currently leads operational initiatives at APEX.

Nadav Delgo

Co-founded Tinu Israel (AI infrastructure) and leads people and talent at APEX. He served as a commander in elite IDF special forces, then moved to Unit 8200 and Unit 81, working in cyber and quantum computing.

Tamir Meerovitch

Part of the founding team at APEX. He also leads business development at Frost & Sullivan in Israel and is an early-stage angel investor, focusing on exceptional teams building in AI infra and cybersecurity.
